summary: Linkers Industries Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine corporate governance change: the board approved an increase in authorized shares from 4,000,000 to 10,000,000 ordinary shares (Class A and Class B), effective upon registration of amended articles in the British Virgin Islands, which occurred on July 30, 2026. This is an administrative charter amendment with no transaction, pricing, or strategic significance. It does not constitute a special situation under the defined categories; it is a routine current report about share capital structure.
